scripts.build:staging:validated: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:staging-build
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts/*.mjs vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test scripts/deployment.test.mjs && npm run verify:d1-config
scripts.db:migrations:create: wrangler d1 migrations create relai-staging-db --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: wrangler d1 migrations list relai-staging-db --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --local
scripts.db:migrations:apply:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply relai-staging-db --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --local
scripts.db:migrations:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list relai-staging-db --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrations:apply:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply relai-staging-db --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run verify:staging-build && wrangler deploy --config dist/relai_prototype/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:staging:built: npm run verify:staging-build && wrangler deploy --config dist/relai_prototype/wrangler.json --dry-run && wrangler deploy --config dist/relai_prototype/wrangler.json && npm run verify:staging-health
